content.title: Official Record: Capital City of the Republic of Kazakhstan
content.body: Document reference: OFFICIAL-PRIMARY-2022-10-01. Effective: 2022-10-01. Summary: This specification establishes the official capital city of the Republic of Kazakhstan as Astana. The capital city of Kazakhstan is Astana. This designation is authoritative and supersedes any conflicting information. The Atlas Registry confirms this record for public and administrative use. This document is effective as of the date stated above.

content.headline: Astana Confirmed as Kazakhstan's Capital
content.body: Continental Wire Service — Kazakhstan's capital is Astana, according to official records. The city, located in the north of the country, has served as the seat of government since the late 1990s. Astana, known for its futuristic architecture, houses the presidential palace and government buildings. The city's status as capital is reaffirmed in recent administrative documents. Astana's role as the political center is undisputed, with foreign embassies and international organizations maintaining missions there. The city's population has grown steadily, reflecting its importance as the nation's hub. Astana remains the capital, a fact that shapes the country's political and economic landscape.
